memory.caveat: These are read-only replay workers: the in-memory store retains candidate history that production stores durably, so this is not a measured production peak. The bound includes four copies of the largest replay worker plus 0.75 GiB headroom; parent/other resident processes need additional RAM. Process trees were sampled every 100ms and include live OCR descendants; short-lived children can escape sampling.

limitations: Saved source responses are replayed at controlled clocks; this is not a fresh publisher check tomorrow.
Every held site is checked through each distinct published county/town scope and the actual ZIP-precision panel; post-shipping real-home-address checks remain separate.
Calling an eligible scope through the exact job does not prove RN-01 admission launches it in production.
An unsuccessful source acquisition remains a failed pass with retained production data; it is not counted as a successful publish.
Preserving site IDs in the typed reader does not prove a reader geography can see them. Any sampled panel gap is reported separately.
A next-day controlled-clock replay proves ordinary cadence and repeat publication against these saved responses; tomorrow's publisher/network availability is outside this read-only proof.
